newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 24 die as India bus falls into gorge.
newsitem.headline: At least 24 die as India bus falls into gorge.

text.p: At least 24 people were killed and 35 injured when a bus carrying them to a wedding fell into a deep gorge in the hills of northern Uttar Pradesh state, the United News of India (UNI) said on Sunday.
UNI said the accident occurred in the Pauri district, 300 km (190 miles) northeast of New Delhi, on Saturday evening.
The agency quoted authorities as saying that 20 people died on the spot and four died of their injuries in a nearby hospital. No further details were immediately available.
An estimated 50,000 people die in road accidents in India every year.
